note: Meta Nervus eval scenarios (first slice). Every expected value is copied from a committed record on main, not invented. This harness scores stub honesty: whether every committed Nervus record says it is a stub, and whether the numbers in it are the stub's own fixed values. No model is loaded, no model is scored, and nothing here is evidence about a model. The harness never runs the hosted entry point: that run appends to the ledger and rewrites the receipt, so the harness reads the committed files only.
